summary: On the global session/plugin object dword_7CD8C0, invokes its vtable slot at offset +28 twice: first with argument 36, then with argument 35. Each returned object pointer, when non-null, is passed to StateCleanupNotification (0x00489CB0). Returns the result of the second StateCleanupNotification call, or the second vtable call result when null.

operations.description: Invoke vtable[+28] on dword_7CD8C0 (global object pointer) with argument 36; store the returned pointer in v0.
If v0 is non-null, pass it to StateCleanupNotification (0x00489CB0); the return value of that call is discarded.
Invoke the same vtable[+28] on dword_7CD8C0 with argument 35; store the returned pointer in result.
If result is non-null, call StateCleanupNotification(result) (0x00489CB0) and return its value.
Return result unchanged when the second vtable call returned null.
